attrs.def: anything that exists — a thing, a living being, a place or an idea
something alive — it grows, reproduces and needs energy
a living thing
a living thing that moves and eats other living things
an animal with a backbone
an animal without a backbone
a warm-blooded animal that nurses its young
an animal with feathers, a beak and two wings
an animal that lives in water and breathes through gills
a cold-blooded animal with scaly skin
a soft-skinned animal that lives both in water and on land
a tiny animal with six legs and a three-part body
an animal with eight legs and an exoskeleton
a mostly-water animal with a hard shell and many legs
a soft-bodied animal, often inside a shell
a living thing that makes its food from sunlight
a tall plant with a woody trunk
a blossoming plant
a living thing that feeds on decay, like a mushroom
a living thing too small to see
a creature from stories and legends, not nature
a dog-family mammal — it hunts or was tamed from hunters
a cat-family mammal — a stealthy hunter with sharp claws
a bear-family mammal — big, strong and heavyset
a horse-family mammal — built for running on open land
a cattle-family mammal — hoofed and grass-eating
a gnawing mammal with big front teeth
an ape-family mammal with grasping hands
a mammal that carries its young in a pouch
a whale-family mammal that lives its whole life in the sea
a hoofed, plant-eating mammal
a thought or concept that lives in minds
